fusions.name: Snagging Cast
fusions.desc: A thrown barb that deals 8 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Wrench It Free
fusions.desc: Tears the barb free in a blow that deals 18 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and uses up every affliction you have on it, with 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Reeled In
fusions.desc: Collapses a point 6 tiles across ahead of you for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches is slowed 20% for 2 seconds and left [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Already Caught
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
